name: ste-writing
title_zh: AI 腔文档过一遍航空级受控英语改写
tagline_zh: 文档读着像 AI 写的、术语飘忽、句子越读越糊？它按 ASD-STE100 逐句重写，只动文字不碰代码。
tagline_en: Docs that read like AI wrote them? It rewrites prose sentence by sentence to ASD-STE100, leaving code untouched.
desc_en: Rewrite prose (docs, handbooks, user guides, READMEs, PR descriptions, error messages, release notes, comments, tool descriptions, system prompts — never code) into ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English to remove "AI slop". Use when asked to make writing not sound like AI, make docs clear or plain, enforce a controlled writing style, review text for STE violations, or write technical documentati
why_zh: 不是润色，是套一套有词表和句长上限的受控语言规则，把模糊表达逼成唯一读法。
why_en: Not polishing — it applies a controlled-language ruleset with a fixed vocabulary and sentence limits, forcing vague prose into.
limit_zh: 只改散文，代码、配置、命令一律不碰；规则基于 ASD-STE100，面向技术文档，营销文案和文学性表达会被削平。
limit_en: Prose only — code, configs and commands are untouched. ASD-STE100 rules flatten marketing or literary voice and do not certify aviation compliance.
title_en: Rewrite AI-sounding docs into ASD-STE100 Simplified.
